assay: bulk RNA-seq, Illumina NovaSeq 6000, 150 bp paired-end, Lianchuan Biotechnology; aligned to mouse GRCm39 (S2.8.p1)
samples: C2C12 mouse myotubes treated with 20 uM Icariin or vehicle for 24 h, n = 3 per group (S2.8.p1, S3.3.p1); no caffeine/exercise-mimetic stimulation is stated for the sequenced cells
exercise_factor_in_transcriptome: none: the in vivo exercise tests (S2.2) used mice that were not sequenced; the caffeine 'exercise-like stress' model (S2.4.p2) is not part of the RNA-seq description (S2.8.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of Icariin (20 uM, 24 h) versus vehicle on the C2C12 myotube transcriptome; a drug effect, not an exercise effect
planned_contrasts: Icariin vs vehicle in C2C12 myotubes (S3.3.p1; paper: 1919 DEGs, 1134 up / 785 down)
paper_results: 1919 DEGs (1134 up, 785 down) at |log2FC| > 1 and padj < 0.05 (S3.3.p1); GO up: regulation of mitophagy, mitochondrial degradation involved in mitophagy, oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial inner membrane; GSEA positive for mitophagy sets (S3.3.p2); qPCR Pink1, Parkin, Bnip3, Ulk1 up (S3.3.p3)
